text:
kevin: quick q — for hotfixes that touch config parsing, are we treating those as patch bumps or minors? our release pipeline currently auto-bumps minor for any change touching schema files.

marta: patch unless it's a breaking change. adding optional fields -> patch, removing/renaming -> minor.

raj: fwiw CI classified last week's proto tweak as minor and that created an extra release that wasn't necessary.

sophie: can we tighten the rules in release-tools? my vote: only BREAKING CHANGE or feat! -> minor. everything else -> patch. also: tag format should be annotated git tags like `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with the changelog snippet in the tag message.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting deployment for release v1.8.2 (sha: abc1234). change window: 2025-09-13 02:00 UTC.

jen: we should also define rollback tag conventions. if we rollback to the previous patch, we must not reuse tags. propose `v1.8.2-rb1` or `v1.8.2+rb1`? we need something easy to parse.

raj: semver says metadata after + isn't considered for precedence, dash is prerelease. i'd prefer `-rb1` so it sorts earlier, but either is ok as long as we don't reuse.

marta: `v1.8.2-rb1` looks fine. also update release notes with explicit "rolled back to" line and link to the rollback PR. do not overwrite tags.

kevin: also note for Dedicated customers: we allow pinning by tag in console. docs should recommend pin to exact tag for guaranteed repeatability; we can support `v1.8.*` style channel pins but call out caveats.

sophie: action items: 1) release-tools PR to only auto-bump minor on BREAKING/feat! or explicit "bump: minor" commit; 2) add rule for proto changes: add-with-default -> patch, remove/rename -> minor; 3) document `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` annotated tags + rollback suffix `-rbN`.

jen: I'll open the PR to release-tools now, will add tests for proto heuristics and include tag format doc.

kevin: anyone object to `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` annotated tags + rollback suffix `-rbN`? :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: to veto.

raj: :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

sophie: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deployment v1.8.2 completed successfully (sha: abc1234).

kevin: thanks all — we'll merge the PR and roll the rule into the next release cycle.
